nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So... You're saying you like me?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Well... That is...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You're really great, Kim... I mean that.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And normally, I'd go out with you in a second...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I can't be thinking about who to date right now...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I've got other things to worry about...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Like winning the FLEX-Games! My family could really use the cash.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Stupid... Boys... Why do I have to be the one freaking out about all this?

nodes.text: Spike is probably just off somewhere skateboarding without a care in the world right now...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh! There it is!

nodes.speaker: Mallika

nodes.text: Ahhh!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wait... That's not where it would be at all!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess I'll just wear what I already have on...

nodes.text: Mallika rushes home and immediately starts changing her clothes, cleaning her room, and hiding embarrassing toys!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry, Bartholomew T. Bear, but you've got to go into your 'cave' under the bed for a few hours...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ahhh! And where's my cutest top?!
Quick! Think of a logical place to look for your top!
Where would you put your clothes?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I've always loved your green, spiky hair...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I've been thinking of dyeing mine purple... But I'm scared to do it by myself.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hehe. I remember how freaked out I was the first time I went green.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So... Will you come over and help me?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure thing. It's the hair-dyers code. I've got to help you, just like some older skaters helped me back in middle school!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'll come over in an hour.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks, Spike! You're the best!
Spike hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Nice... He's coming over!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh no... What's wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Shoot... If I say I have a cough, he won't want to kiss me...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... I have something wrong with my... Feet.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ew... Like some kind of rash?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Man... I guess I can pick you up some foot cream and come over. But keep your socks on, okay?
Spike hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well... At least he's coming over...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But I'm not exactly doing my best to seduce him.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You need to start playing dirty!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay. I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Excellent. Just do what I said.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'm going to head down to the beach to see if any cute boys are around...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I'll expect details in a few hours.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I... I guess I'd better do this now, or I never will...
Mallika calls Spike.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, Spike?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh... Hey, Mallika. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I, er, really need your help...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Sure thing... With what?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Shoot! I'm so bad at this... Why didn't I think of a lie `before` I called him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Shoot! I'm so bad at this... Why didn't I think of a lie [color=#3b78e2][i]before[/i][/color] I called him?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... I need you to...

options.label: Get me some medicine... I'm sick!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: No! Wrong answer!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But I thought you said...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Men are hunters, Mallika! They're the lions... You have to be the gazelle!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But really `you're` just an even bigger lion pretending to be a gazelle!
nodes.text_bbcode: But really [color=#3b78e2][i]you're[/i][/color] just an even bigger lion pretending to be a gazelle!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Or... Actually, you're like some kind of shark that can walk around on land but looks like a cute panda bear.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: ...And when the guy comes close enough, you bite him in the head!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... I guess I see your point? Kind of?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Look... Forget all that shark-lion stuff.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The point is...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You let him see how much hotter you are than Kim...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: But the whole time, you've got to play hard to get!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Then, when he gets close, you can totally push him away... Maybe even make out with some other guy he knows!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: That way he'll realize what a catch you are!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not really sure that's my style.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... Like your 'style' ever got you anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I went out with Phil for years! We had an awesome relationship!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... Right up until the day he dumped you.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I... I guess I see your point.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Good girl. Then here's what you have to do...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Urk...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh no! Do you need to go to the hospital too?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No... I mean... I just wanted to say that you're, uh...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So... Good at skating!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh! Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I just hope I'm good enough to win the FLEX-Games... My family could really use the cash.
Back at Ms. Rose's house...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Now you run along and have fun with someone your own age...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And by that, I mean with that boy over there.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose! I'm not just going to leave you on your own...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah... And I really need to get home anyway...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll say goodbye to Spike, then come right back here to make sure you're actually getting some rest!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It sounds like I have no choice.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Promise you'll actually take a break?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: My word! Well, I'm not one to sit on my duff and watch the television.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But perhaps a short respite is in order.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay. See you soon...
A few minutes later, Kim and Spike stand next to his family car as he gets ready to leave...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's cool that you're friends with Ms. Rose...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: She's feisty... Kind of like you.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: He's looking right into my eyes! What do I say?! Panic mode!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh dear... As busy as I keep you in the bakery, I suppose you don't have much time for boys...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose! It's not that! It's just that... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: 'Uh'?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So... Embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well... I think it's nice that you're good friends.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I wish I'd known to value friendships with higher regard at your age...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Not that I really believe you, of course...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I can tell you two have the hots for each other!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Hehe. You young folks crack me up!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yep! That's him... The old 'ball and chain'...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hehe. Yeah. We can barely keep our hands off each other.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We'd probably be kissing right now if you weren't in the car!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh my!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hehe. We're joking, Ms. Rose.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim and I are just friends.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well, being 'just' friends is nothing to sneeze at.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I wish I'd known to value friendships with higher regard at your age...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Aw... Ms. Rose is sweet...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But it `was` nice to pretend I was actually going out with Spike for a second...
nodes.text_bbcode: But it [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] nice to pretend I was actually going out with Spike for a second...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Too bad it was only imaginary...
Later, at the hospital...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So... Is your grandma going to be okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: She's not my grandma...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: She's my best friend.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: She's okay.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: For now...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What... What's wrong with her?

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Unfortunately, since you're not family, I'm not really legally allowed to say...

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: But your friend Ms. Rose... She's just...

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Well, she's awake now. I can tell you that much.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Can... Can I see her?

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Of course... You can even take her home.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: She says she 'won't stay in this hospital another darned minute.'

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That sounds like her...
Later, Spike drives Kim and Ms. Rose home...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I must say, I am `quite` embarrassed.
nodes.text_bbcode: I must say, I am [color=#3b78e2][i]quite[/i][/color] embarrassed.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Imagine all those nice boys in the ambulance having to drive me all the way to the hospital...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Speaking of nice boys...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Is this young man your boyfriend, Kim?

nodes.subtitle: Two girls who like one guy? This could be trouble!

nodes.text: It's a sunny Saturday morning... Most of the Centerscore High kids are still sleeping...
But not Kim. She's been at the bakery since before dawn, getting the dough ready and starting up the ovens.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay... That takes care of the last of the bagels. Everything should be ready by the time we open.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, Ms. Rose?
Suddenly, Ms. Rose's knees start to buckle!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Cough... Grkkk...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose!
Kim runs over to Ms. Rose's side as the old woman collapses to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh no! What do I do?
Act normal. Don't be nervous.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I think I pretty much understand her overall point.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh, Kim. Thanks for putting up with me and my dusty old tale.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: You're such a good listener!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks, Ms. Rose! I like listening to your stories!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tell me more about what happened with Walter and Mary!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... I'm getting kind of confused.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh dear... I shouldn't be blabbing on about this dusty tale.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well, don't worry. I won't go on for another second.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: In fact... Maybe you should let me have a little time alone.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Shoot... She seems upset.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait! Ms. Rose... I'm sorry I got confused!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I just, uh, have a really short attention span!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Please, please, please tell me the rest of the story!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well... If you insist...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Weeks went by. At night, I'd sneak off to the lake or the beach to see Walter...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And in the daytime, I'd work with Mary at the bakery!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Elizabeth, I did it! I figured out the last ingredient for our recipe!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Here... Try a bit of this.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Munch... Munch...

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: This is the best thing I've ever tasted!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: What was the final ingredient?

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: It's funny... Living so close to the ocean, you'd think we would have thought of it sooner.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: It's...

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: Elizabeth!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Walter? What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: There's something I need to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Walter! Not here. Can't it wait?

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: That's just the thing... It can't!

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: My `draft deferment` just got canceled!
nodes.text_bbcode: My [color=#e23b3b][i]draft deferment[/i][/color] just got canceled!

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: I'm supposed to report for active duty... `Tomorrow morning!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm supposed to report for active duty... [color=#e23b3b][i]Tomorrow morning![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh no! What happened to Walter? What happened with you and Mary? What happened with the recipe?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Kim... It's been a long day...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And I'm feeling a bit weaker than I may have let on earlier.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I think you'd better let me rest for a while.
Looks like the end of this story will have to wait...
Too bad... But there are other exciting things going on!
Let's check in on Spike and Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Soon, Walter and I were going steady...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: We were happy as clams.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: ...But at work, things were rather awkward.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Oh, applesauce!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: What happened to these cookies? They're all broken!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Sorry... I must have messed them up. I've just been down in the dumps lately!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Walter hasn't come into the bakery in ages, and Peggy said she saw him with another girl at the beach!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Well... I'm sure if he's going steady with someone, it must be because it's true love.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: But... What about `my` true love?
nodes.text_bbcode: But... What about [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] true love?

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Not to contradict you... But before Walter, weren't you swooning over `Charlie Chimplin?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not to contradict you... But before Walter, weren't you swooning over [color=#3b78e2][i]Charlie Chimplin?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: And before that, weren't you 'in love' with `General Georgio Patson?`
nodes.text_bbcode: And before that, weren't you 'in love' with [color=#3b78e2][i]General Georgio Patson?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: That was different!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Walter is the one.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Poor Mary... I really did behave quite badly. I was a moll! A Sheba!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose seems pretty worked up! I really should listen.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But I'm having some trouble understanding her story. Some of the words she uses are so old-fashioned.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'd better really concentrate. She can always tell when I don't understand what she's talking about!
Pick the real old-fashioned expressions! Avoid fake ones!
Which expression is real?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: That's so like you, Kim... Always thinking of someone else.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I was very different at your age...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: So... You're sure Walter didn't come by earlier?

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: I haven't seen him.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I feel like such a Dumb Dora... I was going to give him this special lemon bar today.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: But I guess I baked it for nothing.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Well... At least we still have each other... Even if we don't have fellas.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Hey... What's that sticking out of your apron? A letter?

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: It's... From... Er... President Troosevelt!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Keen! Can I see it?

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Uh... No. It's very... Uh... Naughty?

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Oh my! Does Meleanor Troosevelt know about this?

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: That's even worse!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: The letter explained everything...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I'd been the object of Walter's desire all along!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: He'd only talked with Mary before because he was too shy to talk to me!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: You're just like I was, Kim...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Only thinking about the guy...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: When I should have been thinking about how Mary would feel!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I did end up meeting up with Walter...

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: I'm so glad we're finally on a date...

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: I kept going to that bakery, trying to work up the gumption to ask you out.

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: But then I'd always get all yellow-bellied and talk to your friend Mary instead.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Uh, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: I hope she wasn't too upset when you told her we were going on a date.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Yeah... About that... I didn't exactly tell her.

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: That's a hoot! I've always wanted to have a secret sweetie pie!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Hehe. You're quite the charmer...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And I can't say I'm proud of my actions...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I worked at the bakery myself when I was your age...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It was the spring of 1944, and I was in high school.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Back then, no one called me 'Ms. Rose'... I was 'Elizabeth'.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Unlike you, I had a friend my age who worked with me. My best friend, in fact. Mary.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: We both loved baking. We were like two peas in a pod...
As Ms. Rose tells her tale, Kim closes her eyes and pictures Ms. Rose as a young woman...
Let's flash back to 1944 and see what happened!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I had a new idea for that `secret recipe` this morning.
nodes.text_bbcode: I had a new idea for that [color=#3b78e2][i]secret recipe[/i][/color] this morning.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Double-candied pecans.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Of course! That should balance out the acidity of the lemon extract!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I can't believe we're actually trying a recipe this complex.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: It's bonkers!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Deranged!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Bananas!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh, we were quite the pair...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Until `he` came along.
nodes.text_bbcode: Until [color=#3b78e2][i]he[/i][/color] came along.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I hope Walter stops by again today...

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: You mean that blonde guy with the big shoulders?!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: I've seen you talking to him... He's the cat's meow!

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: I know... I'm a little head over heels for the fella to be square with you...

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Well... I'm going to get some dough from the back.

nodes.speaker: Mary
nodes.text: Shout if he shows up!

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Look! It's him!

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: Uh... Hi.

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: Uh... Um...

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Aw. He's all tongue-tied and adorable.

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: My mom and pop sent me down to pick up a loaf of sourdough.

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: Sure! Let me get that for you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I picked out an extra-big loaf...

nodes.speaker: Elizabeth
nodes.text: There you go.

nodes.speaker: Walter
nodes.text: And there `you` go.
nodes.text_bbcode: And there [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] go.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: He handed me a note!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Then he smiled at me...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And he stumbled awkwardly out of the bakery.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow! What did the note say?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It was a love letter, of course!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait... Did you...

options.label: Did you end up going out with him?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I see... Shyness has never been my problem, I'm afraid.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Quite the opposite in fact.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh... I was a brash young thing at your age.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Another girl... I see.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: You might be surprised to hear I have some experience in such matters.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose! I mean... You fought another girl for a guy?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It wasn't much of a fight really...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Anyway... I got you that hair dye!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's really brave of you to commit like this... It takes way longer for girls to grow their hair out!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Actually... I'm kind of having second thoughts.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hmm... Maybe purple isn't right for you... Have you thought about red?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Actually, Spike... I'm not really sure I want to dye my hair at all...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: See... I actually wanted you to come here for another reason.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... So... Your house is kind of... Big.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah... It's weird for me actually...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: My mom finally paid off her medical school debt last year, so now we actually have money for the first time...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So my parents made a few improvements around the house.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But at least I made them install energy-efficient light bulbs and a swamp cooler to save electricity!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No... No, it's cool that you guys are doing so well.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'd love to get a house like this for my mom one day if I make the big time.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You seem kind of tired, Mom... Why don't you let me drive Chip to his potluck thing?

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: That would actually be nice. Thanks, Spike.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure thing, Mom.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Thanks for driving me...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No sweat, little bro.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's good that we're getting some quality time together.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You been working on your rail grinds?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Heh. Yeah. Have you seen my knees lately?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm scared to look.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I've got a scab that looks like Pelvis Parsley.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Nice! You should put it up on P-Bay when it peels off.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I guess we could use the money, huh?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't worry, little bro... Mom'll find a new job.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And even if she doesn't, I'll have that prize money from the FLEX-Games soon!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Nice. So I won't have to sell my scab on the internet after all!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hopefully...
Later, after Spike has dropped Chip off at the potluck...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa! Look at the size of this place! Does Mallika really live here?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey... Sorry I'm late.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You're right on time! Come on in.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey... I'd better get going too.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: But you just got home!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I know... But I've got a lot to do today!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: And you think I don't?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, it's not exactly like you have a job anymore.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Wait... I didn't mean...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: No... You're right, Spike. You should go.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa! Look at the size of this place! Does Mallika really live here?
Spike knocks on the door.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ah! Spike! What are you doing here already?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You... You can't look in my room yet! Or at me! Don't look at me!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You look fine!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Just 'fine'?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Geez... So much for worrying about being late!
Meanwhile, back at Spike's house...
Spike has just gotten home to find his mom and nine-year-old brother, Chip, in the dining room.
We'll let you play as Spike for a little bit!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: There you are, Spike!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Did you, uh, get a chance to ask your friend about the cookies?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sorry... Something else kind of... Came up.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Spike! Now what's Chip supposed to bring to his class potluck?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: It's okay, Mom... No one will notice.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: It's not okay...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: What I really need is money to fix the oven...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: But that's not going to happen anytime soon...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Okay, Chip, go get your shoes on. We're going.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mom seems so stressed out... Maybe I should drive Chip to his potluck...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I promised Mallika I'd be over at her place soon...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Listen, Kim...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I... I really appreciate that we can just have dinner without you bringing up dating.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And I'm really sorry if it seems like I'm leading you on or something.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Why is it that when I'm looking for a girlfriend, I can never find anyone to date...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But when I'm not looking at all, `two` girls come along at the same time?!
nodes.text_bbcode: But when I'm not looking at all, [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] girls come along at the same time?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh, look... Maybe it's just not the right time for this.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean... Maybe my heart's not in it either.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll see you later, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim... Wait.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't let this be the last time we hang out...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike... I really do like hanging out with you...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But I know I don't have it in me to fight another girl for a guy right now.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll see you later, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim...
Meanwhile, at Mallika's house.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...So after you told me about Kim and Spike, I called him up and had him come over!

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: You were here with a boy... Unsupervised?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Gulp.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: I'm just joking, Mallika. I trust you.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: But I think you misunderstood about your friend, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: The old woman she works with is quite ill... Kim and Spike had rushed her to the hospital .

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh... Huh. I feel kind of bad now.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: It's not your fault, dear...

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Just remember... It's easy to get competitive over a boy. But you're a nice girl. Right?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: Good... Because your friend Kim is going to need all the support she can get.

nodes.speaker: Doctor Patel
nodes.text: I'm afraid her boss, Ms. Rose, won't be around much longer...
And so ends part one of our story...
Well, it's not much of an ending at all!
There are mysteries left unsolved, decisions yet to be made... And perhaps, tragedies on the horizon!
Unfortunately, you'll have to wait until the next episode to find out what happens!
But wait, there's more!
That's right... Through either magnificent luck, great skill, or simple dogged determination, you've managed to unlock the `special bonus scene!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's right... Through either magnificent luck, great skill, or simple dogged determination, you've managed to unlock the [b]special bonus scene![/b]

nodes.text: We hope you enjoy it!
At Chip's class potluck...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I can't believe I didn't get to bring anything to the school picnic...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I totally wanted to impress...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: There... There they are! The twins!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Okay, stay calm, Chip... Nothing to be nervous about... Just the two prettiest girls in the world...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Are you okay, Chip?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You seem a little nervous.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What are these... Feelings?!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hehe. What a dork.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Let's go eat a tray of brownies!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Later, Chip!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What... What's wrong with me? Why can't I talk to them?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Well... Maybe I'll be braver when I'm older...
Aw... It looks like the love bug has bitten everyone, young and old!
We'll have to keep an eye on young Chip to see if he can impress Kay and Kel!
For now, though, well played! We'll see you next episode!
One more thing... You're just shy of a perfect score and a `special bonus scene!` Think you've got what it takes to unlock it?
nodes.text_bbcode: One more thing... You're just shy of a perfect score and a [b]special bonus scene![/b] Think you've got what it takes to unlock it?

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But wait...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What am I saying? I mean... Mallika was totally honest with her feelings, and I totally rejected her!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What if I made a huge mistake?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And... It seems like you don't really care if we date or not, right?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I don't care?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah! Mallika is the one that's actually passionate!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait... But...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I mean... Think about everything we've said tonight.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm too stressed to date you, and you're too overwhelmed to date me.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So that means I have to date a girl who's ready to support me... Someone like Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But... Don't worry! You and I can still be really good buddies.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I've even been thinking about working on my diss-battling skills lately... Maybe we could form a team!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It'll be just like the good old days, except you'll be my partner instead of $Josh's!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You and me... On a diss-battling team...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And... You're going out with someone else.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And I have a crush on you the whole time!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You... You have that crazed look on your face again.
A few minutes later, outside...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Capp
nodes.text: Thank goodness you're here, officer... There seems to be some kind of wild animal loose inside my restaurant!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What type of beast are we talking about? Siberian Tiger? Jackalope? Orc?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Rawwwwwr!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Capp
nodes.text: I'm afraid it's even worse, officer... It's a crazed high school girl!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Great googly-moogly.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I... Er... Left my Kevlar vest back at the station...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'll see you later!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Capp
nodes.text: Why do I get the feeling he isn't coming back?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Rawwwr! Grrr!!!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Somebody help! Anybody!
Wow... Kim is one girl you don't want to get mad!
Somehow, we don't think this is the best way for things to turn out.
Maybe you should play again... And give Kim a bit more help in the romance department!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Good... Then let's cut to the chase.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's time to talk about the real reason I'm here at this dinner...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I want us to be partners!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: 'Partners'?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Like 'life partners'?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Not exactly...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I was thinking more along the lines of 'partners in crime'!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I've got an awesome scheme to extort money from Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now I'm really confused.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I've been thinking about it, Kim...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You and I are buddies, and Mallika `clearly` likes me...
nodes.text_bbcode: You and I are buddies, and Mallika [color=#e23b3b][i]clearly[/i][/color] likes me...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And my mom could sure use some money...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So here's what we'll do! I'll tell her I'm going out with you...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Then you go to her and offer to take $5,000 to 'break up' with me!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We'll split the money 70/30!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Then we can run away to Mexico and catch our own shrimp for sustenance!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It's a foolproof plan!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But that's just... That's just wrong.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So what?! Mallika's not even a nice girl... And she's got plenty of money!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Plus, we can hang out all the time!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Um... Good? Sort of...
Well, Kim seems pretty unsure that this is how things should turn out...
And we `know` this isn't the best ending!
nodes.text_bbcode: And we [b]know[/b] this isn't the best ending!

nodes.text: If you want to really beat this episode, you'll have to play well as both Mallika `and` Kim!
nodes.text_bbcode: If you want to really beat this episode, you'll have to play well as both Mallika [b]and[/b] Kim!

nodes.text: Go back and give it one more shot!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim, I...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Oh, quit stringing her along, Spike... It's time for you to go out with a `real` woman!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, quit stringing her along, Spike... It's time for you to go out with a [color=#3b78e2][i]real[/i][/color] woman!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: That's right, Kim... It's me...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: And I'm here to ask Spike on a date!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Really?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Of... Of course I'd go out with you!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: WHAT?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No offense, Kim... But think about it. You and Mallika are both too immature for me!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I need a woman with some experience!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose... How could you do this to me?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Sorry, dearie... But like I told you in my story today...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: I'm the type of lady who steals boys from other girls! Always have been, always will be.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Now come give me a kiss, Spikey-poo. I just washed my dentures!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Smooch!
Whoa. Who saw that coming?!
Definitely not us...
You must have played so badly that you altered reality!
Quick, play again so you can restore the world to its rightful condition!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: She basically lied to me so I'd go over to her house...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I mean, if she wants to be friends, fine, but don't lie to me and pretend to be my friend when you really want something else!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah... Totally... I would `never` do that.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Yeah... Totally... I would [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] do that.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Honestly... I'm worried you'll start going out with her, and then I'll never get to... Hang out with you again.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, that's blunt.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I appreciate that.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I mean... We're friends, right? We should be honest with each other.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Honestly, I got really, really frustrated earlier at Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So... You're not jealous?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh... I guess I was confused. I guess I thought... You know... You liked me.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh wait! I mean... I do like you.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: So you like me... But you're not jealous when I hang out with Mallika?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm not sure I believe you...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I don't know if I can trust Mallika either.
A few minutes later, Kim and Spike are sitting and talking...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...And then on top of everything, our oven broke! The same day my mom lost her job! I mean, come on!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike's such a nice guy... I can tell he really cares about his family.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That sounds really stressful.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah... And then there's Mallika, putting all this pressure on me to...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sorry! I got so caught up in my story I forgot I shouldn't be talking about her!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You were hanging out with Mallika earlier?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I mean... That's okay, right?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I've never felt better.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But why are you gritting your teeth like that?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It, uh, a jaw-strengthening exercise.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Really? Maybe I should try it too.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I hope I'm still able to chew at dinner.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry... Yeah. Let's sit down and eat... If you can.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's just been rough with Ms. Rose.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I was just so scared this morning...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And then she spent all day telling me this intense story.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sorry... I really want this to be a fun dinner.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey... It's okay.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I had a tough day too...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Really? Oh huh... Maybe you can tell me about it.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure thing. But let's get a table first.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike... If you were my boyfriend, I'd support you in whatever you wanted to do.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I mean... I'd be your biggest cheerleader, and you could be mine too!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Aw... Mallika... That actually sounds really nice.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But... You're coming on really strong.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And you're not listening. I just don't have it in me to be in a relationship right now.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You deserve an awesome boyfriend... And I don't think I can be him right now.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'd better go... I have to meet a friend for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: See you soon...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I don't get it... I followed Nicole's advice...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So why won't Spike go out with me?
One more switch...
You'll play as Kim in this last scene! Go get 'em!
In the fight for Spike's heart, Mallika is a tough opponent.
But Kim isn't the type to give up easily...
Let's see how her dinner with Spike goes!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: On any other day I'd be totally excited to be getting dinner with Spike.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But today... I've got other stuff on my mind.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean... Why was Ms. Rose telling me that story?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Was it just because she got sick this morning and started thinking about her life?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Or did she sense me falling into the same trap?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean, how far am I willing to take this?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Is it worth fighting for Spike if I hurt Mallika?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But... It's not like she's my good friend or anything. Just kind of an acquaintance...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean... I guess we got a little closer at that 'Assassins' concert... And we hung out when we made that skate video...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait... Is... Is Mallika my `friend?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Is... Is Mallika my [color=#3b78e2][i]friend?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Why can't I just like a guy who likes me and me alone?! Why do I always have to compete against some other girl?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa! You look... Uh... Scary.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Is everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You should totally work at my mom's office!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Her last secretary left to join some sort of commune in the woods...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So you could have the job.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... Wouldn't it be hard for me to do that and still stay in school?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh yeah... I guess she's open while we're at school most days...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Also... I really think I have a shot at winning the FLEX-Games!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Of... Of course!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I know you'll win! You're the best!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well... I haven't won anything yet...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And I like to think of myself as an underdog.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But I appreciate the vote of confidence!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I've been really preoccupied lately... Worrying about my family.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: My mom got laid off from Prince Automotive a few weeks ago.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And the skate shop went out of business last month, so I lost my job there...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's why I need to win the FLEX-Games!
Now we know what Spike is thinking a little better...
Let's slip into Mallika's brain and check in on her thoughts!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Once I get the prize money, I can pay off my mom's house, fix up all our broken appliances... All kinds of stuff!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: ...And have some more time to date girls!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But is winning the FLEX-Games really realistic?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: The competition will be a bunch of pros.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Maybe it would be better if Spike earned money another way...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Like working at my Mom's office!

options.label: I know you can win the FLEX-Games!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You... You like Kim?
Mallika is on the verge of tears.

nodes.speaker: Spike

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
